# Sluggers

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

leaders <- Batting |>
	group_by(playerID) |>
	summarize(
		career_home_runs = sum(HR),
		first_year = min(yearID),
		last_year = max(yearID),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	inner_join(
		People |>
			select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
		by = "playerID"
	) |>
	mutate(
		player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
		steroid_era = if_else(
			last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
			"Career overlaps steroid era",
			"Career does not overlap steroid era"
		)
	) |>
	arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
	slice_head(n = 15) |>
	select(player, career_home_runs, steroid_era)

ggplot(
	leaders,
	aes(
		x = career_home_runs,
		y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
		fill = steroid_era
	)
) +
	geom_col() +
	labs(
		title = "Career home run leaders and the steroid era",
		x = "Career home runs",
		y = "Player",
		fill = "Career overlap",
		caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
	)

Batting |>
	filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
	ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
	geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
	labs(
		title = "Barry Bonds: home runs by season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs",
		caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
	)
```
